decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting remains a very niche and strategically distant offering, and the lack of later website visibility makes it a likely candidate for withdrawal in favor of core and new LED-focused development.

Industrial explosion-proof luminaires fit our industrial customer base and engineering capabilities very well, so despite limited later web evidence this line is still strategically strong and likely to be retained.

The pendant office luminaire is close to our core commercial lighting business, but as a narrower single product it faces some portfolio rationalization risk alongside other office and pendant offerings.

The premium pendant luminaire line supports our established professional lighting position, offers stronger differentiation and margin potential, and the multiple-model format suggests ongoing commitment.
